targetTexts.2: “How long will you torment me and crush me with your words?
targetTexts.3: Ten times now you have reproached me; you shamelessly mistreat me.
targetTexts.4: Even if I have truly gone astray, my error concerns me alone.
targetTexts.5: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace against me,
targetTexts.6: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
targetTexts.7: Though I cry out, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.
targetTexts.8: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.
targetTexts.9: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.
targetTexts.10: He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.
targetTexts.11: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.
targetTexts.12: His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
targetTexts.13: He has removed my brothers from me; my acquaintances have abandoned me.
targetTexts.14: My kinsmen have failed me, and my friends have forgotten me.
targetTexts.15: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.
targetTexts.16: I call for my servant, but he does not answer, though I implore him with my own mouth.
targetTexts.17: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.
targetTexts.18: Even little boys scorn me; when I appear, they deride me.
targetTexts.19: All my best friends despise me, and those I love have turned against me.
targetTexts.20: My skin and flesh cling to my bones; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
targetTexts.21: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.
targetTexts.22: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?
targetTexts.23: I wish that my words were recorded and inscribed in a book,
targetTexts.24: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.
targetTexts.25: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
targetTexts.26: Even after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God.
targetTexts.27: I will see Him for myself; my eyes will behold Him, and not as a stranger. How my heart yearns within me!
targetTexts.28: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him,’
targetTexts.29: then you should fear the sword yourselves, because wrath brings punishment by the sword, so that you may know there is a judgment.”
